session_rubric.notes: 4 separate video files. Choosy used. Wrong target (Label→Energy→Label cycling). Tested 4 different predictors (Fat, Saturated Fat, Energy, Carbohydrate). Test switch occurred in video 4. No audio.

B3.note: Label dragged as predictor in video 1, then corrected. Energy dragged as target in video 2 (non-binary column — produces invalid split). Correction made. Two wrong-target events = B3-A1 confirmed.

B9.note: Test switch visible in video 4. No verbal confirmation of purpose. Choosy used so split was intentional. B9-A1 confirmed; B9-A2 cannot be confirmed without audio.
